searchText: https://twitter.com/algo_class/status/1393221114017501190 Once 1559 is live on mainnet, what are some metrics that people would like to track, aside from the obvious total ETH burnt? I'm wondering if there is anything that would require setting up infrastructure basically around the fork block and that would otherwise be lost. Even without that constraint, what are things people would like to monitor about the mechanism? Regarding tracking ETH burnt, will it be a dashboard showing a daily, monthly, yearly, lifetime burnt?
